home.heroTitle: We play several times a week. Come to the next one.
home.intro: D&D, Delta Green, Dragonbane and two dozen more systems. Never played? We'll teach you at the table — bring nothing.
home.reassure: First game is free. Newcomers turn up every week.
home.evidenceTitle_one: {{count}} game played — every one of them rated
home.evidenceTitle_other: {{count}} games played — every one of them rated
home.evidenceTitleApprox: {{count}}+ games played — every one of them rated
home.evidenceSub: We don't promise "regular meetups". Here's how many games actually happened, and how the players themselves rated them.
home.whyTitle: Why come and play with us
home.why1Body: Plenty of people come to us for their very first game ever. The GM explains the rules as you play, so it's enough to just turn up and give it a go.
home.why2Body: Dice, rulebooks, character sheets and pencils will already be on the table. All that's left for you is to pick a character and step into the adventure.
home.why3Title: Meeting people is part of the game
home.why3Body: New players join our tables regularly. Come on your own — we'll introduce you to everyone and get you into the game quickly.
home.why4Title: The first game is a great way to try
home.why4Body: Your first game is free, so you can simply come along, see how it works and spend an evening in new company. And if you want more, the next adventure is already waiting.
home.recentSub: Players rate every game in Telegram afterwards. We show all of them — the good and the not-so-good.
home.systemsSub: If there's something specific you're after, chances are we've already run it. The number is how many games we've played.
home.upcomingSub: The calendar updates whenever a GM schedules a new game.
home.joinTitle: Message us and we'll seat you at a table this week
home.joinSub: Tell us whether you've played before and when suits you. We'll match you to a game for your level and schedule.

about.title: About Us
about.body: We're a group of friends who get together to play tabletop RPGs. This site tracks who's run and played what, so we can look back on the campaigns we've shared.

gameMasters.title: Game Masters

signup.title: Join the Club
signup.intro: Leave your details — we'll get in touch and find a game that fits your experience and schedule.
signup.submittedBody: Thanks! We'll be in touch soon.
signup.reachGroupHint: Either one is enough: Telegram/Viber or phone.

login.title: Log in and see the club from the inside
login.intro: No passwords: sign in with the same Telegram account you rate games with in the chat.
login.benefit1Body: Visitors see players under generated nicknames. Logged in, you see who was actually at the table.
login.benefit2Body: Leave your take on any game — and read what everyone else made of it.
login.benefit3Body: Photo and bio. If you run games, that's exactly what shows on your public Game Master page.
login.widgetHint: Telegram will ask you to confirm. We only receive your name and @username.

profile.title: My Profile
profile.bioGmHint: (shown on your public Game Master page)
profile.avatarHint: Upload a new profile picture (JPEG, PNG or WebP).
profile.gmIntro: Your photo and bio appear on the public Game Masters page — they're what someone choosing a table actually sees.

admin.title: Admin
admin.anonymizeLabel: Replace player names with nicknames for logged-out visitors
admin.systemsHint: Games are counted by poll title: if it starts with the system's name or one of its aliases, it counts. Click a system to edit it.
admin.aliasesPlaceholder: Aliases, comma-separated, e.g. Каїрн, Cairn RPG
admin.confirmDeleteSystem: Delete the system “{{name}}”? Its games stay, but won't count toward it any more.
admin.unmatchedHint: Polls whose title didn't match any system. Add an alias to the right system and they'll count.

statistics.title: Club Statistics
statistics.intro: Players rate every game in Telegram right after it ends. Everything below comes out of those ratings.
statistics.noGamesInPeriod: No games logged in this period.

telegramApp.openFromBot: Open this from the club's Telegram bot to see your stats.
telegramApp.title: Hi, {{name}}!
telegramApp.createPollIntro: The poll goes into the club chat, where players can rate the session right away.
telegramApp.createPollPreview: In the chat it will look like this:
telegramApp.createPollDoneBody: Take a look at the club chat — players can vote already.
telegramApp.createPollNotMember: Only members of the club chat can create a poll.
telegramApp.createPollNoSystems: No systems yet — an admin has to add them on the site first.
telegramApp.noRatingsYet: You haven't rated any games yet — use /rate in the chat!
telegramApp.feedbackAdventureHelp: How much did you like or dislike the game's concept, plot, world-building, characters, and everything else around your character?
telegramApp.feedbackTableHelp: How comfortable or uncomfortable was it playing with the other players — did the group click, or was the game a struggle?
telegramApp.feedbackGmHelp: In your opinion, did the GM run the game well? How good or bad was their performance?
telegramApp.feedbackSelfHelp: How satisfied are you with your own play — your roleplaying, decision-making, and so on? Did you do your role justice, or could you have done better?
telegramApp.feedbackTextHelp: You can write detailed feedback here if you'd like, but it's optional. By default the GM will see this feedback is from you — uncheck the box below if you'd rather send it anonymously.
telegramApp.feedbackRevealLabel: Let the GM see that this feedback is from me
telegramApp.feedbackThanksBody: Your feedback has been sent to the GM.
telegramApp.feedbackNotEligible: Since you haven't rated this game yet, you can't leave extended feedback.
telegramApp.feedbackAlreadySubmitted: You've already submitted extended feedback for this game.
